node.label: Food security & PDS
node.summary: Public distribution system, food grains and the NFSA.

facts.text: The **National Food Security Act, 2013** covers up to **75% rural and 50% urban** population; free grain under **PMGKAY** was extended for five years from **1 Jan 2024**.
facts.plain: The National Food Security Act, 2013 covers up to 75% rural and 50% urban population; free grain under PMGKAY was extended for five years from 1 Jan 2024.

facts.text: Karnataka seized **17.78 lakh kg** of diverted PDS rice and grains since 1 Aug (Belagavi over 5 lakh kg), filed 238 FIRs and arrested 215. Food Minister: **Rizwan Arshad**.
